package.name: cite_skills
package.description:
L3: robot-agnostic capability servers.
Skills are the vocabulary the system speaks about work. Goals are in task space, never joint space — a joint-space goal leaks the robot's kinematics upward and breaks the promise that swapping an xArm 5 for a different arm changes nothing above this line.
C++ because every skill sits on a motion path, and cross-cutting-safety.md requires simulation-only code to be audited as if it were hardware code.
